key_impacts: Fishermen lost most of their fishing boats
Parts of local mangrove forests remained underwater
Properties in low-lying coastal areas were destroyed
Few lives were lost due to timely coast guard warnings
evidence_snippets: Fishermen lost most of their fishing boats. Parts of our mangroves are still under water.
A lot of properties in the low-lying areas were destroyed; very few lives were lost.
missing_information: Exact numbers of casualties, boats lost, and properties damaged are not stated
